versions.label: 3rd Rescheduling (Dec'22)
versions.regulatoryReference: DFIM Circular 04/2021; 3rd Rescheduling Dec'22 (after BB approval)

notes:
CWTP (Chittagong Waste Treatment Plants Limited) history reconstructed from the merged repayment-schedule workbooks. All source workbooks share the identical "Original 101,956,538.05 + Expansion 50,030,231.72 = 151,986,769.77" consolidated opening balance and 13.7% rate as their common baseline, so the 5 chronological versions below all chain off that figure and off each other's closing/rolled-forward balances.

1. 1ST RESCHEDULE (2013, "Reported/CWTP_ Loan _merged_1st_rescheduled_2013.xlsx"): the root-level file "CWTP_ Loan _merged_rescheduled.xlsx" (also in the assigned file list) is byte-for-byte IDENTICAL to this Reported version (verified via diff) - treated as one event, only the Reported copy is cited as sourceFile per the borrower instructions. Drawdown/effective 2013-07-01, first installment 2013-09-30, Annuity, 13.7% flat, 26 quarterly installments, fully amortizing by 2020-06-30. A separate small side-facility, "CWTP_ overdue_repayment_schedule.xls" (overdue interest+LPC of 11,374,538.97 at 16%, 14-month tenor, serviced 2013-07 to 2014-08 in parallel), and "CWTP_Loan - expansion_modified.xls" / "CWTP_Loan - restructured.xls" (pre-2013 tranche-level schedules for the "Expansion" and "Original" components respectively, which sum to the 151,986,769.77 consolidated balance) were reviewed but are background/supporting schedules that feed INTO the 1st Reschedule's opening balance rather than being independent reschedule events themselves - not given separate version entries, but their figures cross-check cleanly against the 1st Reschedule's stated Original/Expansion breakdown (101,956,538.05 + 50,030,231.72).

2. RESTRUCTURED 21-05-14 ("CWTP_ Loan _merged_restructured_21-05-14.xlsx"): a file dated three weeks before the above, but its Repayment Schedule sheet shows a DIFFERENT amortization from row 3 onward (2014-03-31) - it extends the principal grace period two more quarters (to 2014-09-30 vs the 1st Reschedule's 2014-03-31) and reduces installment count from 26 to 23, producing a materially different (flatter, then front-loaded) principal path even though rate/loan amount/tenor start are otherwise identical. Given genuine ambiguity about whether this is an independent interim restructuring (a grace-period correction booked shortly after the 1st Reschedule was initially filed) or a superseded draft, it is reported here as its own RESTRUCTURE version per the task's fallback instruction ("do your best... note the uncertainty") - flagged with LOW CONFIDENCE. It is fully overridden row-by-row from the workbook and, like the 1st Reschedule, fully amortizes to zero by 2020-06-30.

3. 2ND RESCHEDULE (effective 07-Nov-2016): DE-DUPLICATED per instructions. "CWTP_ Loan _merged_2nd_rescheduled_08-02-16.xlsx" is an earlier/incomplete DRAFT (only 32 installments, terms "effective from 01 Jul'15" at 10%, ending 2023-06-30, and it does NOT fully amortize - closing balance is ~0 only due to a plug, but its principal path diverges oddly at row 39-40, 2015-06-30/09-30, suggesting a mid-draft correction). "CWTP_ Loan _merged_2nd_rescheduled_07-11-16.xlsx" is the LATER, COMPLETE, FINAL version (48 installments, terms "effective from 07 Nov'16" at 10%, fully amortizing to 2028-09-30) and was used as the canonical version per the instruction to prefer the later/more complete file. The "Reported/CWTP_ Loan _merged_2nd rescheduling considering DFIM 6_Feb'21.xlsx" file is actually a LATER, separate merged-history document (filed ~Feb 2021) that reproduces this same 07-11-16 schedule for 2016-2020 and then APPENDS the DFIM-6 pandemic moratorium (2020-2022) on top of it - it is the source used for both version 3 and version 4 here since its 2016-2019 rows exactly match the 07-11-16 standalone file. capitalizedAmount/overdueAmountRolledIn (26,271,198.15) = the jump in opening balance between the pre-2nd-reschedule closing balance (182,662,517.27 as of 2016-10-02) and the new opening balance (208,933,715.42 as of 2016-12-29); this reconciles with the workbook's own "Interest capitalized under 2nd Rescheduling (BB Authorized 07.11.16)" = 7,050,356.05 plus prior 2nd-rescheduling-related overdue interest/principal/LPC accrued 2014-2016.

4. DFIM 6 MORATORIUM (MORATORIUM_EXTENSION, effective 2020-03-31): captured from the same "2nd rescheduling considering DFIM 6_Feb'21" Reported file, whose filename explicitly references DFIM 6 per the borrower notes - regulatoryReference set to "DFIM Circular 6 (pandemic-era repayment relief)" as instructed. This is a 12-quarter zero-principal (fully capitalizing) stretch from 2020-03-31 through 2022-12-31 - the CWTP_Loan sheet's own labels ("Mar'20 Interest payment/Due/Partial capitalization" ... "Total Capitalization-DFIM" = 16,512,753.62 and "Total Capitalization-3rd" = 20,856,995.35) were cross-verified against the schedule rows and sum exactly to this version's capitalizedAmount (37,369,748.97 = ending balance 244,603,733.52 minus opening 207,233,984.55). Loan does not amortize during this stretch (finalClosingBalance = opening balance of the following version, not zero).

5. 3RD RESCHEDULING Dec'22 (RESTRUCTURE - both rate AND tenor/frequency changed, so not classified as RATE_CHANGE): sourced from "Reported/CWTP_ Loan _merged_3rd_Rescheduling_Dec'22.xlsx" (root-level file of the same name was also reviewed and its Repayment Schedule/CWTP_Loan sheets are identical in substance to the Reported copy - only trivial cached-float formatting differences from openpyxl were seen in the Summary sheet, not a real numeric discrepancy). Rate cut from 10% to 9% (independently verified via day-count back-calculation: implied annual rate = interest x 360 / (opening x days) = 0.09 exactly), payment frequency changed from quarterly to MONTHLY, tenor set to 15 installments per the workbook's own "Number of installments" = 15 label (though the actual schedule in the Reported file runs 81 monthly rows to 2029-09-30 with a broadly level ~9.15-9.35M/quarter-equivalent total debt service - the "15" label appears to refer to a different/superseded sub-count and the full 81-row schedule from the workbook was used and fully verified to amortize to ~0 by 2029-09-30). No new LPC was generated at this event (no new LPC Calculation sheet vs. the 2nd Reschedule's two LPC sheets, which were carried over unchanged) - regulatoryReference cites DFIM Circular 04/2021 (the moratorium's originating circular per the "DFIM Restructuring 2021" label seen in the CWTP_Loan sheet) alongside the 3rd Rescheduling approval itself.

All principal_type values for override-driven (non-1st-reschedule) versions are set to "Scheduled Principal" per the same convention used for MCML/SKS in examples.ts, since these historical schedules cannot be cleanly regenerated from an annuity/level formula and are instead pinned via opening_balance_amounts/interest_payment_amounts/closing_balance_amounts overrides for every row. num_installments/tenorMonthsAfter for versions 1-3 are reported in calendar terms (quarters x 3); version 5 (3rd Reschedule) is monthly so tenorMonthsAfter is a straight month count matching the 81 actual rows found in the workbook (not the "15" label, which is noted as an unresolved inconsistency in the source file).
